tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer mdor bsdus pa'i rim pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru lo ke shwa ra ya/

gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi rgyal po gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab gter dam chos 'dus pa skor dgu'i ya gyal/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len mdor bsdus te nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ: ye nas ma skyes stong gsal ngang: kun snang byang chub sems sprin las: rang byung rig pa hrīḥdakar gsal: hrīḥlas bh+rūm̐ 'phros gzhal yas khang: dal dbus pad+ma'i snying po zlum: 'dab drug mu khyud pad sdong mdzes: gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs: mnyam yangs 'od kyi khang par gsal: de dbus rang rig hrīḥ'od 'bar: rnam smin lus bsregs hrīḥde nyid: nyi zla pad steng thugs rje che: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: phyag g.yas pad phreng thugs kar 'dzin: phyag g.yon pad steng bdud rtsi'i bum: rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: rang 'dra'i yum mchog gsang ye ma: lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'khril: 'ja' ris 'od lnga'i rgyab yol mdzes: spyi gtsug rigs bdag 'od dpag med: thugs kar rta mgrin ye shes sems: rigs 'dus rang las sprul pa'i 'khor: nor 'dzin sras mchog g.yas nas 'dud: gsang sngags 'dzin ma g.yon nas 'dud: 'dab drug bcom ldan thub drug dang*// phyi rim sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis// sgo bzhir khrag 'thung rigs bzhi sogs// bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i sprin// thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'gro ba drangs shing bsgral slad du// dug lnga'i tshul gyis dug lnga 'joms// sarba dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pas dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ hrī: ye nas rang byung thugs rje che: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs: ye shes lnga bdag cod pan dbang: 'bru brgyad gsal bsgom rang dbang thob: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: sa rgyas gdab cing dbang bskur/

hrī: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das: bde chen chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rtsol bral mtshan bcas mi dmigs kyang: thugs rje nyi gsal 'od bzhin du: 'khor 'das mnyam sbyor thugs rje'i bdag: rigs bdag gtso 'khor sprul pa'i tshul: dkyil 'khor phyag rgyar skur bzhengs la: dam tshig dkyil 'khor bdag la dgongs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ru ṇi kā maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra e h+ye hi sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes pas spyan drang*/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya sa/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos/ na mo pū ru sha ya ho: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: sa phyag bya/ hrī: kun 'byung nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: bdug spos me tog mar me dri: bshos gtsang sil snyan rol mo dang: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi dang: 'dzin chags bral ba'i gtor ma dang: rigs drug bsgral pa'i rak+ta dang: gnyis med sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ru ṇi kā gu h+ya dz+nyā na sarba yo gi nī badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ta na ga ṇa dharma dhā tu sarba pū dza ho: zhes mchod cing bstod pa ni/ hrī: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: ye nas rang byung thugs rje'i sku: 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs 'dus rang las sprul 'khor rnams: 'gro 'dul phrin las cir yang ston: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bdag: bdud bzhi 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas pa ni/ hrī: lha gsum thugs kar zla ba'i steng: hrīḥmathar yi ge drug mas bskor: bdag nyid rtsa ba'i thugs ka nas: sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po 'phros: bde gshegs kun gyi sku la phog:

sku mchog mnyes nas dngos grub thob: bdag la 'dus shing 'od zer des: khams gsum sems can lus sgrib sbyangs: sems can lus kun dbang du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: zhes bzla zhing*/ de bzhin du/ spyi gtsug snang mtha'i thugs ka nas: sngags phreng 'od zer dmar po 'phros: bde gshegs kun gyi gsung la phog: gsung mnyes gsung gi dngos grub thob: khams gsum sems can ngag sgrib sbyangs: sems can ngag kun dbang du gyur: zhes dang*/ rta mgrin thugs ka'i sngags phreng las: 'od zer mthing ga rab 'phros pas: bde gshegs kun gyi thugs la phog: thugs mchod mnyes nas dngos grub thob: khams gsum sems can yid sgrib sbyangs: sems can kun yid dbang 'dus gyur: zhes so sor bzlas pa ci nus dang/ skabs su lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rig stong gnyug ma'i rang bzhin du shes par byas la/ de'i ngang nas bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du btson/ thun mthar mchod cing bstod la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur nas: zhes sogs bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// zhes pa'ang gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs don nyung gsal snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis bya bral ma ṇi ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa ste/ dge bas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
